summaries.zh: Stop AI coding agents from guessing. MCP server + Claude Code plugin that enforces intent alignment BEFORE coding: PRD → intent-confidence gate → Mermaid contracts (state machines / sequence diagrams / decision tables) → mechanical lint with zero CRITICAL → then code. Human-in-the-loop, file-persisted, zero-config.
